description: Get every DNS answer a name has given, newest first: the records seen when public pages using it were scanned and the addresses it resolved to when TLS certificates for it were published, each with first and last seen. For a domain this includes its _dmarc record and a wildcard probe; for an IP address, its reverse-DNS (PTR) names. DNS lookups during scans started on 28 October 2026. name is a hostname, domain or IP address; limit is 1 to 500.

name.description: Hostname, domain or IP address whose DNS answers to list, for example login.example.com.
name.title: Name
